[Click here](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-e-fhyujo-hhlljjcji-h/) **For Immediate Release:** October 23, 2026**Contact:** Kylie Glatfelter, Communications Director, [kglatfelter@indiana.gop](mailto:kglatfelter@indiana.gop)**President Trump Backs Max Engling for Indiana Secretary of State****Indianapolis, Ind. **- Indiana Republican Party Chairwoman Lana Keesling released the following statement on President Donald J. Trump's endorsement of Max Engling for Indiana Secretary of State."Congratulations to Max Engling on receiving the endorsement of President Donald J. Trump."President Trump's endorsement is a tremendous show of confidence in Max's leadership and his commitment to election integrity. Max has made protecting Indiana's elections a cornerstone of his campaign, with a clear focus on upholding the law, exposing corruption, holding wrongdoers accountable and maintaining Hoosiers' trust in the electoral process. With Election Day quickly approaching, this endorsement brings even more momentum to this critical race."### [](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fhyujo-hhlljjcji-r/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fhyujo-hhlljjcji-y/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fhyujo-hhlljjcji-j/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fhyujo-hhlljjcji-t/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fhyujo-hhlljjcji-i/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fhyujo-hhlljjcji-d/) ** PAID FOR BY THE INDIANA REPUBLICAN STATE COMMITTEE. ****NOT AUTHORIZED BY ANY CANDIDATE OR CANDIDATE'S COMMITTEE. ****WWW.INDIANA.GOP.** | Indiana Republican State Committee 101 W.
